Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ أَحَدًا لَا يَبْلُغُ مِنْ شُكْرِكَ غَايَةً
Translation: O Allah, no one can reach the ultimate limit in thanking You

Arabic text: إِلَّا حَصَلَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ إِحْسَانِكَ مَا يُلْزِمُهُ شُكْرًا
Translation: Except that they would have received from Your favors that which requires even more gratitude

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَبْلُغُ مَبْلَغًا مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَ إِنِ اجْتَهَدَ
Translation: And no one can reach the highest degree in obeying You, even if they strive

Arabic text: إِلَّا كَانَ مُقَصِّرًا دُوْنَ اسْتِحْقَاقِكَ بِفَضْلِكَ
Translation: Except that they would still fall short of what Your grace deserves

Arabic text: فَأَشْكَرُ عِبَادِكَ عَاجِزٌ عَنْ شُكْرِكَ
Translation: Even the most grateful of Your servants is incapable of thanking You properly

Arabic text: وَ أَعْبَدُهُمْ مُقَصِّرٌ عَنْ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And the most devoted of them falls short in obeying You

Arabic text: لَا يَجِبُ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَهُ بِاسْتِحْقَاقِهِ
Translation: No one deserves that You forgive them based on their merit

Arabic text: وَ لَا أَنْ تَرْضَى عَنْهُ بِاسْتِيجَابِهِ
Translation: Nor that You be pleased with them based on their worthiness

Arabic text: فَمَنْ غَفَرْتَ لَهُ فَبِطَوْلِكَ
Translation: So whoever You forgive, it is by Your generosity

Arabic text: وَ مَنْ رَضِيْتَ عَنْهُ فَبِفَضْلِكَ
Translation: And whoever You are pleased with, it is by Your grace

Arabic text: تَشْكُرُ يَسِيرَ مَا شَكَرْتَهُ، وَ تُثِيبُ عَلَى قَلِيلِ مَا تُطَاعُ فِيهِ
Translation: You appreciate the little gratitude shown to You, and reward even the smallest act of obedience

Arabic text: حَتَّى كَأَنَّ شُكْرَ عِبَادِكَ الَّذِيْ أَوْجَبْتَ عَلَيْهِ ثَوَابَهُمْ
Translation: As if the gratitude of Your servants for which You obligated their reward

Arabic text: وَ أَعْظَمْتَ عَنْهُ جَزَاءَهُمْ
Translation: And for which You have greatly magnified their recompense

Arabic text: أَمْرٌ مَلَكُوْا اسْتِطَاعَةَ الِامْتِنَاعِ مِنْهُ دُونَكَ
Translation: Was something they had the power to withhold from You

Arabic text: فَكَافَيْتَهُمْ، أَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ سَبَبُهُ بِيَدِكَ فَجَازَيْتَهُمْ
Translation: So You rewarded them, or as if its cause was not in Your hands, so You compensated them

Arabic text: بَلْ مَلَكْتَ يَا إِلَهِيْ أَمْرَهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمْلِكُوْا عِبَادَتَكَ
Translation: But in fact, O my God, You possessed their affairs before they possessed the ability to worship You

Arabic text: وَ أَعْدَدْتَ ثَوَابَهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفِيضُوْا فِيْ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And You prepared their reward before they began to obey You

Arabic text: وَ ذٰلِكَ أَنَّ سُنَّتَكَ الْإِفْضَالُ
Translation: And that is because Your way is to bestow favors

Arabic text: وَ عَادَتَكَ الْإِحْسَان، وَ سَبِيلَكَ الْعَفْوُ
Translation: Your habit is to do good, and Your path is forgiveness

Arabic text: فَكُلُّ الْبَرِيَّةِ مُعْتَرِفَةٌ بِأَنَّكَ غَيْرُ ظَالِمٍ لِمَنْ عَاقَبْتَ
Translation: All creation acknowledges that You are not unjust to those whom You punish

Arabic text: وَ شَاهِدَةٌ بِأَنَّكَ مُتَفَضِّلٌ عَلَى مَنْ عَافَيْتَ
Translation: And they bear witness that You are gracious to those whom You pardon

Arabic text: وَ كُلٌّ مُقِرٌّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّقْصِيرِ عَمَّا اسْتَوْجَبْتَ
Translation: And each admits their own shortcomings regarding what You deserve

Arabic text: فَلَوْ لَا أَنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَخْتَدِعُهُمْ عَنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا عَصَاكَ عَاصٍ
Translation: If Satan did not deceive them from obeying You, no one would disobey You

Arabic text: وَ لَوْ لَا أَنَّهُ صَوَّرَ لَهُمُ الْبَاطِلَ فِيْ مِثَالِ الْحَقِّ
Translation: And if he did not present falsehood to them in the image of truth

Arabic text: مَا ضَلَّ عَنْ طَرِيقِكَ ضَالٌّ
Translation: No one would stray from Your path

Arabic text: فَسُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَبْيَنَ كَرَمَكَ
Translation: Glory be to You! How evident is Your generosity

Arabic text: فِيْ مُعَامَلَةِ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ أَوْ عَصَاكَ
Translation: In dealing with those who obey You or disobey You

Arabic text: تَشْكُرُ لِلْمُطِيعِ مَا أَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَهُ لَهُ
Translation: You thank the obedient one for what You Yourself have bestowed upon them

Arabic text: وَ تُمْلِيْ لِلْعَاصِيْ فِيمَا تَمْلِكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُ فِيهِ
Translation: And You give respite to the disobedient one when You could hasten their punishment

Arabic text: أَعْطَيْتَ كُلًّا مِنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَجِبْ لَهُ
Translation: You have given each of them what they did not deserve

Arabic text: وَ تَفَضَّلْتَ عَلَى كُلٍّ مِنْهُمَا بِمَا يَقْصُرُ عَمَلُهُ عَنْهُ
Translation: And You have favored each with what their deeds fall short of

Arabic text: وَ لَوْ كَافَأْتَ الْمُطِيعَ عَلَى مَا أَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَهُ
Translation: If You were to reward the obedient only for what You had enabled them to do

Arabic text: لَأَوْشَكَ أَنْ يَفْقِدَ ثَوَابَكَ
Translation: They would be on the verge of losing Your reward

Arabic text: وَ أَنْ تَزُولَ عَنْهُ نِعْمَتُكَ
Translation: And Your blessings would cease for them

Arabic text: وَ لٰكِنَّكَ بِكَرَمِكَ جَازَيْتَهُ
Translation: But by Your generosity, You have rewarded them

Arabic text: عَلَى الْمُدَّةِ الْقَصِيرَةِ الْفَانِيَةِ بِالْمُدَّةِ الطَّوِيلَةِ الْخَالِدَةِ
Translation: For their short, fleeting time with an eternal, lengthy period

Arabic text: وَ عَلَى الْغَايَةِ الْقَرِيبَةِ الزَّائِلَةِ بِالْغَايَةِ الْمَدِيدَةِ الْبَاقِيَةِ
Translation: And for their near, passing goal with a lasting, extended one

Arabic text: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَسُمْهُ الْقِصَاصَ فِيمَا أَكَلَ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ
Translation: Then You did not hold them accountable for consuming Your sustenance

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ يَقْوَى بِهِ عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: Which gave them strength to obey You

Arabic text: وَ لَمْ تَحْمِلْهُ عَلَى الْمُنَاقَشَاتِ فِيْ الْآلَاتِ
Translation: Nor did You burden them with detailed questioning about the faculties

Arabic text: اَلَّتِيْ تَسَبَّبَ بِاسْتِعْمَالِهَا إِلَى مَغْفِرَتِكَ
Translation: Which they used to seek Your forgiveness

Arabic text: وَ لَوْ فَعَلْتَ ذٰلِكَ بِهِ
Translation: And if You had done that with them

Arabic text: لَذَهَبَ بِجَمِيْعِ مَا كَدَحَ لَهُ
Translation: They would have lost all that they had earned

Arabic text: وَ جُمْلَةِ مَا سَعَى فِيهِ
Translation: And all that they had strived for

Arabic text: جَزَاءً لِلصُّغْرَى مِنْ أَيَادِيْكَ وَ مِنَنِكَ
Translation: As payment for just the smallest of Your favors and gifts

Arabic text: وَ لَبَقِيَ رَهِينًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ بِسَائِرِ نِعَمِكَ
Translation: And they would remain indebted before You for all Your other blessings

Arabic text: فَمَتَى كَانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ شَيْئًا مِنْ ثَوَابِكَ لَا مَتَى
Translation: So when would they ever deserve any of Your reward? Never!

Arabic text: هَذَا يَا إِلَهِيْ حَالُ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ وَ سَبِيلُ مَنْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ
Translation: This, O my God, is the state of one who obeys You and the path of one who worships You

Arabic text: فَأَمَّا الْعَاصِيْ أَمْرَكَ وَ الْمُوَاقِعُ نَهْيَكَ
Translation: As for the one who disobeys Your command and violates Your prohibition

Arabic text: فَلَمْ تُعَاجِلْهُ بِنَقِمَتِكَ لِكَيْ يَسْتَبْدِلَ بِحَالِهِ فِيْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
Translation: You do not hasten Your vengeance so that they may replace their state of disobedience

Arabic text: حَالَ الْإِنَابَةِ إِلَى طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: With a state of repentance and obedience to You

Arabic text: وَ لَقَدْ كَانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ فِيْ أَوَّلِ مَا هَمَّ بِعِصْيَانِكَ
Translation: Yet they deserved, from the first moment they contemplated disobeying You

Arabic text: كُلَّ مَا أَعْدَدْتَ لِجَمِيْعِ خَلْقِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ
Translation: All the punishment You have prepared for Your entire creation

Arabic text: فَجَمِيعُ مَا أَخَّرْتَ عَنْهُ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ
Translation: So all the punishment You have delayed for them

Arabic text: وَ أَبْطَأْتَ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سَطَوَاتِ النَّقِمَةِ وَ الْعِقَابِ تَرْكٌ مِنْ حَقِّكَ
Translation: And all the retribution You have postponed is a relinquishment of Your right

Arabic text: وَ رِضًى بِدُونِ وَاجِبِكَ
Translation: And an acceptance of less than what is due to You

Arabic text: فَمَنْ أَكْرَمُ يَا إِلَهِيْ مِنْكَ
Translation: So who is more generous than You, O my God?

Arabic text: وَ مَنْ أَشْقَى مِمَّنْ هَلَكَ عَلَيْكَ لَا مَنْ
Translation: And who is more wretched than one who perishes in spite of You? None!

Arabic text: فَتَبَارَكْتَ أَنْ تُوصَفَ إِلَّا بِالْإِحْسَانِ
Translation: Blessed are You! You can only be described by benevolence

Arabic text: وَ كَرُمْتَ أَنْ يُخَافَ مِنْكَ إِلَّا الْعَدْلُ
Translation: And You are too generous for anything but justice to be feared from You

Arabic text: لَا يُخْشَى جَوْرُكَ عَلَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ
Translation: No one fears Your injustice toward those who disobey You

Arabic text: وَ لَا يُخَافُ إِغْفَالُكَ ثَوَابَ مَنْ أَرْضَاكَ
Translation: Nor do they fear that You will neglect to reward those who please You

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ هَبْ لِيْ أَمَلِي
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family, and grant me my hope

Arabic text: وَ زِدْنِيْ مِنْ هُدَاكَ
Translation: And increase me in Your guidance

Arabic text: مَا أَصِلُ بِهِ إِلَى التَّوْفِيقِ فِيْ عَمَلِي
Translation: By which I may attain success in my deeds

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ مَنَّانٌ كَرِيمٌ
Translation: Indeed, You are the Bestower, the Generous
